manifest.name: Fabel
manifest.description: Stream audiobooks from a Norwegian Fabel subscription (unofficial community provider).

phone.title: Fabel login
phone.description: Sign in with the same Norwegian mobile number as in the Fabel app. You must accept Fabel's terms before we request an SMS code. Only existing accounts are supported.

otp.title: SMS code
otp.description: Enter the code you received by SMS.

profile.title: Listening profile
profile.description: Choose which Fabel profile to use (sent as x-profile-id).

errors.godta_vilkar: Accept Fabel's terms and privacy policy to continue.
errors.ingen_profiler: No listening profiles on this account.
